title: allow editing the stepInputMessages through prepareStep
body:
### Description

Would it be possible to also allow editing the stepInputMessages through prepareStep?
I am using an agent with many steps, and often it accumulates input tokens, increasing the cost greatly. (if accumulated 5K tokens and have 20 more steps, I am paying for 100K tokens for the steps.)
I hope to apply cacheControl option to one of the stepInputMessages in the middle of streamText steps to decrease the cost burden.

Thank you!

### AI SDK Version

aisdk: 5.0 beta


related PR:
https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/5991

linked_prs.title: feat (ai): step input message modification in prepareStep
linked_prs.body:
## Background

In longer agentic loop, it can be helpful to modify step input messages for e.g. prompt compression or to enable caching.

## Summary

Add message as input and output to `prepareStep`.

## Tasks

- [x] streamText test case
- [x] generateText test case
- [ ] docs
- [x] changeset

## Related Issues

Fixes #7151

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns memory-related behavior (editing stepInputMessages to manage token accumulation) and agent workflow (step management), both of which are agent-specific components. The related PR modifies agent orchestration logic, confirming it as an agent issue.
